contract.application_relevance: Workers build routers relative to a service base and need both captured route values and traceable original inputs.
contract.candidate_classification: assertion-bearing ordinary API correctness candidate; no reviewed census credit yet
contract.cleanup: All URL, params, iterator, pattern, array, and result values are request-local. Return from synchronous fetch releases references. No timer, outgoing fetch, binding, durable write, object URL allocation, or retained cross-request capability. External supervisor stops only owned processes and deletes only its fresh deployment/store directory after receipt capture.
contract.desired_behavior: Relative route is /catalog/items/:id; input canonicalizes to shop.example.test and empty port, captures 42, and retains both raw arguments.
contract.distinctness: Pattern constructor and exec base overload, input provenance, and canonical component mapping.
fixed_runtime_assertions: t.equal(pattern.pathname, '/catalog/items/:id', 'relative pattern resolves against base directory');
t.equal(result !== null, true, 'relative input matches after canonicalization');
t.deep(result.inputs, ['items/42', 'https://SHOP.example.test:443/catalog/'], 'result retains input and explicit base arguments');
t.equal(pattern.test('https://shop.example.test/other/items/42'), false, 'valid URL outside base path is a nonmatch');
contract.hypothesis: Pattern or input base resolution may disagree, or the result may confuse raw input arguments with canonicalized component inputs.
contract.mechanism: URLPattern string/base overload and canonicalized match-input host seam
contract.ordinary_input_scope: Successful public API calls on complete ordinary URL strings or valid property, pair, and pattern inputs. Valid URL nonmatches are intentional boolean/null outcomes, never malformed-input probes. Example domains and documentation IPv6 addresses are data only.
preconditions: Fresh isolated fixture deployment on the exact reviewed direct-celld build; external source/build/process witness required.
Global URL, URLSearchParams, and for U217-U220 URLPattern are supplied by celld, not by Node, a shim, or a mock.
External finite-deadline supervisor and owned-process cleanup are available; missing runtime prerequisites are BLOCKED.
